CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `matieres` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `nom` TEXT NOT NULL, `couleur` INTEGER NOT NULL, `ordre` INTEGER NOT NULL, `masquee` INTEGER NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE matieres ADD COLUMN imageCouverture TEXT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chapitres` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `matiereId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `titre` TEXT NOT NULL, `programme` TEXT NOT NULL, `ordre` INTEGER NOT NULL, `masque` INTEGER NOT NULL, `couleur` INTEGER, `imageCouverture` TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(`matiereId`) REFERENCES `matieres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_chapitres_matiereId` ON `chapitres` (`matiereId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `chapitre_prerequis` (`chapitreId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `prerequisId` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`chapitreId`, `prerequisId`), FOREIGN KEY(`chapitreId`) REFERENCES `chapitres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(`prerequisId`) REFERENCES `chapitres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_chapitre_prerequis_prerequisId` ON `chapitre_prerequis` (`prerequisId`)
ALTER TABLE chapitres ADD COLUMN cleCatalogue TEXT
ALTER TABLE chapitres ADD COLUMN nature TEXT
ALTER TABLE chapitres ADD COLUMN reference TEXT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `formules` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `chapitreId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `intitule` TEXT NOT NULL, `latex` TEXT NOT NULL, `symboles` TEXT NOT NULL, `hypotheses` TEXT NOT NULL, `unites` TEXT NOT NULL, `erreursFrequentes` TEXT NOT NULL, `exemple` TEXT NOT NULL, `programme` TEXT NOT NULL, `statut` TEXT NOT NULL, `signalee` INTEGER NOT NULL, `noteSignalement` TEXT NOT NULL, `ordre` INTEGER NOT NULL, `nature` TEXT, `source` TEXT NOT NULL, `cleCatalogue` TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(`chapitreId`) REFERENCES `chapitres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_formules_chapitreId` ON `formules` (`chapitreId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cartes` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `formuleId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `boite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `prochaine` INTEGER, `nbRevisions` INTEGER NOT NULL, `nbEchecs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `echecsConsecutifs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `derniere` INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(`formuleId`) REFERENCES `formules`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_cartes_formuleId_type` ON `cartes` (`formuleId`, `type`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `revisions` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `carteId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `instant` INTEGER NOT NULL, `reponse` TEXT NOT NULL, `boiteAvant` INTEGER NOT NULL, `boiteApres` INTEGER NOT NULL, `enAvance` INTEGER NOT NULL, `modeObjectif` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`carteId`) REFERENCES `cartes`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_revisions_carteId` ON `revisions` (`carteId`)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `objectifs` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `titre` TEXT NOT NULL, `jour` INTEGER NOT NULL, `chapitres` TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evenements` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `titre` TEXT NOT NULL, `matiereId` INTEGER, `jour` INTEGER NOT NULL, `heure` INTEGER, `salle` TEXT NOT NULL, `colleur` TEXT NOT NULL, `programme` TEXT NOT NULL, `objectifId` INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(`matiereId`) REFERENCES `matieres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_evenements_matiereId` ON `evenements` (`matiereId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_evenements_jour` ON `evenements` (`jour`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evenement_chapitres` (`evenementId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `chapitreId` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`evenementId`, `chapitreId`), FOREIGN KEY(`evenementId`) REFERENCES `evenements`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(`chapitreId`) REFERENCES `chapitres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_evenement_chapitres_chapitreId` ON `evenement_chapitres` (`chapitreId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `documents` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `chapitreId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `titre` TEXT NOT NULL, `chemin` TEXT, `texte` TEXT NOT NULL, `ordre` INTEGER NOT NULL, `ajouteLe` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`chapitreId`) REFERENCES `chapitres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_documents_chapitreId` ON `documents` (`chapitreId`)
ALTER TABLE formules ADD COLUMN favori INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `exercices` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `chapitreId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `numero` TEXT NOT NULL, `titre` TEXT NOT NULL, `statut` TEXT NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `ordre` INTEGER NOT NULL, `modifieLe` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`chapitreId`) REFERENCES `chapitres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_exercices_chapitreId` ON `exercices` (`chapitreId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `exercice_photos` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `exerciceId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sorte` TEXT NOT NULL, `chemin` TEXT NOT NULL, `ordre` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`exerciceId`) REFERENCES `exercices`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_exercice_photos_exerciceId` ON `exercice_photos` (`exerciceId`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `creneaux` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `jour` INTEGER NOT NULL, `debut` INTEGER NOT NULL, `fin` INTEGER NOT NULL, `matiereId` INTEGER, `intitule` TEXT NOT NULL, `salle` TEXT NOT NULL, `professeur` TEXT NOT NULL, `semaines` TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`matiereId`) REFERENCES `matieres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_creneaux_matiereId` ON `creneaux` (`matiereId`)
ALTER TABLE evenements ADD COLUMN duree INTEGER
UPDATE evenements SET heure = 480 WHERE type = 'DS' AND heure IS NULL
ALTER TABLE matieres ADD COLUMN coefficient REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `notes` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `matiereId` INTEGER, `evenementId` INTEGER, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `jour` INTEGER NOT NULL, `valeur` REAL NOT NULL, `bareme` REAL NOT NULL, `coefficient` REAL NOT NULL, `rang` INTEGER, `effectif` INTEGER, `moyenneClasse` REAL, `commentaire` TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`matiereId`) REFERENCES `matieres`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`evenementId`) REFERENCES `evenements`(`id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_notes_matiereId` ON `notes` (`matiereId`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_notes_evenementId` ON `notes` (`evenementId`)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tipe_echeances` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `titre` TEXT NOT NULL, `jour` INTEGER NOT NULL, `faite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tipe_achats` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `nom` TEXT NOT NULL, `prix` REAL, `quantite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `achete` INTEGER NOT NULL, `magasin` TEXT NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tipe_taches` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `texte` TEXT NOT NULL, `faite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `pourLe` INTEGER, `creeeLe` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `taches` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `texte` TEXT NOT NULL, `importance` INTEGER NOT NULL, `faite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `pourLe` INTEGER, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `creeeLe` INTEGER NOT NULL, `faiteLe` INTEGER)
